title: Kununu Company Search Scraper
description: Search Kununu company profiles with names, slugs, locations, industry IDs, ratings, review counts, and links. Batch keywords and page through employer matches.

batch.title: Company search queries
batch.description: Company names or keywords to search across public Kununu employer profiles.
batch.valueDescription: Query used to run this search.

schema.description: Company name or keyword used to search Kununu employer profiles.
Maximum number of company matches requested for this search page.
Number of company matches to skip before returning the next page.
One Kununu country code used to filter search matches. The code is sent as one countries[] value.
Numeric Kununu industry identifier used to narrow a company search.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Kununu company profiles by name or keyword. Export employer slugs, locations, industry IDs, ratings, review counts, and profile links for research.
storeCopy.intro: Search public Kununu company profiles by name or keyword and collect employer slugs, locations, industry IDs, ratings, review totals, and profile links. Batch several searches in one run.
useCases: Recruiters can find employer profiles and review totals by company name.
Labor-market analysts can compare public ratings across employers.
B2B researchers can build company lists with location and industry context.
howToUse: Add a company name or keyword to each entry in `queries`.
Choose country filters and set `limit` and `maxPages` for each search.
Use `maxResults` to cap saved company matches across the run.

faqs.question: Can I search for a partial company name?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use a company name fragment or keyword and review the matched profile names and slugs.

fields.name: id
